conventions.reference: ref41 for group documents, pool_ref41 for pool documents (m03_sub_common.reference)
conventions.method: rule composite assembled (daten/iso/sub/assemble/hyp_assembled_<split>); block unit: nos4 variant
conventions.converter_inputs: The PDF atoms after Docling, the fixed answers, the stored sub-task outputs of the same document, and the export record of the same document (OpenParlData). Never a reference. The S1 files also hold the fields reference and correct; ladder_impl.py drops them when it reads the file.
conventions.open_question: The S1 rule reads export fields (category_de, category_harmonized, name_klasse). If Jonathan rules that only the PDF counts as 'the document', measure the S1 rule again without them for L4 to L10.
conventions.masking: zone atoms: a text answer becomes none on both sides; the atom leaves boundaries, omission, intrusion and class error
conventions.paths: trunk L0 to L2; atom path L3 to L7 (each level adds to its parent); block path L8 and L9 (from L4, with the frame extent abstained instead of the L3 zones); L10 document unit (from L8).

written_affair.definition: The converter claims a document only if two converter signals both give an author role (proposal, response or combined): (1) m03_sub_common.role_of over the families of the text answers of the converter, (2) the S1 combined role of the document. Else the converter abstains on the whole document, and the document leaves the measurement.
inputs: converter answers of the document (13 answers per atom, before the collapse map)
S1 combined role: daten/iso/sub/s1_role/combined_<split>.json, field role (S1 rule; Apertus-v1.5-8B only for the rule id R1)
written_affair.chosen_on: dev (in-sample): the intersection of the U4 signal and the ERR-L4 signal gave the highest exact rate at the atom unit (53 of 146) and at the block unit (108 of 147), and the fewest documents with block intrusion (11 and 15). Script ladder_scope_check.py.

role_agreement.definition: written_affair, and the role of the converter answers is equal to the S1 rule role. Else the converter abstains on the whole document with the reason 'role disagreement'.
inputs: converter answers of the document
S1 combined role (field role)
S1 rule role: daten/iso/sub/s1_role/rule_<split>.json, field role. The S1 rule reads the atoms and the export fields category_de, category_harmonized and name_klasse of the same document.

single_author_agreement.definition: role_agreement, the role is proposal or response, and the S1 Apertus role is the same role. Else the converter abstains on the whole document.
inputs: converter answers
S1 combined role
S1 rule role
S1 Apertus role: daten/iso/sub/s1_role/apertus_<split>.json, field role (Apertus-v1.5-8B, constrained choice; a final run needs CSCS requests in a later step)

interior.definition: Section: a maximal run of one coarse text answer of the converter, with only non-text atoms between its atoms. Zone a: each non-text atom of the converter inside one of its own sections.
inputs: converter answers after the collapse map

edge_blocks_1.definition: Zone b: the first and the last Docling block of each section, and the one block directly before and after it. The block order skips atoms with a fixed answer. Atoms with a fixed answer are never in the zone.
inputs: converter answers after the collapse map
Docling block id of each atom (atom field block)
fixed answers (src/m03_iso_hilfe.py, rules R1, R3, R4, R5)

run_band_3.definition: Text-side band: the first 3 and the last 3 atoms of each maximal run of converter text atoms (any class) in atom order.
inputs: converter answers after the collapse map

units.atom: Each atom gets one coarse answer. The measurement is m03_iso_v4.compare_docs on the transformed answers (collapse map on both sides; a text answer in an abstention zone becomes none on both sides; documents out of scope leave the measurement).
units.block: A block is a maximal run of one coarse text answer over the text atoms of a document; non-text atoms between two runs of the same answer do not split it (E20 chapter 4). The converter claims the class sequence, the boundary positions and the existence of each block. It does not claim the extent: it keeps each atom without a fixed answer as text (S3 all text) and does not isolate the title (S4 not used). Method output: daten/iso/ladder/scratch/err_recompose_nos4_<split>.json (script err_recompose3.py).
units.document: The converter claims, for each document, the set of coarse text classes in its answers. It claims no extent and no position.

metrics.labelled_boundary_f1: compare_docs: boundaries on the text sequence of the reference (carried atoms skipped); a method boundary is correct only if the answers on both sides are equal to the reference. Lower bound: harmonic mean of the one-sided 95 % Jeffreys bounds of precision and recall.
metrics.text_omission: reference text atoms that the converter gives none or furniture, divided by all reference text atoms (atoms outside the zones of claimed documents)
metrics.documents_with_omission: claimed documents with at least one omitted atom
metrics.text_intrusion: converter text atoms that the reference gives none or furniture, divided by all converter text atoms (outside the zones)
metrics.text_class_error: atoms with a text answer on both sides and different coarse answers, divided by atoms with a text answer on both sides
metrics.block_omission: a reference block with no converter text atom on its atoms
metrics.block_intrusion: a converter block with no reference text atom on its atoms (a text field that does not exist)
metrics.exact_atom: all labelled boundaries exact, no omission, no intrusion, no class error (compare_docs)
metrics.exact_block: all labelled boundaries exact, no class error, no atom omission, no block omission, no block intrusion
metrics.exact_document: the set of coarse text classes of the converter is equal to the set of the reference
metrics.exact_rate_lower: one-sided 95 % Jeffreys lower bound of the exact rate (m03_iso_v4.jeffreys_lower)
metrics.coverage_documents: claimed documents divided by all documents of the set
metrics.coverage_ref_text: reference text atoms in claimed documents and outside the zones, divided by all reference text atoms of the set (after the collapse map)
metrics.unsure_share: zone atoms divided by all atoms of the claimed documents
metrics.trivial_role_same_scope: exact documents of the trivial converter 'role only' (each atom without a fixed answer gets the default answer of the S1 combined role) on the documents and atoms that the method claims. A level where this value reaches the method value measures no isolation.

unit_rule.definition: A block is a maximal run of one coarse text answer over the text atoms of a document; non-text atoms between two runs of the same answer do not split it (E20 chapter 4). The converter claims the class sequence, the boundary positions and the existence of each block. It does not claim the extent: it keeps each atom without a fixed answer as text (S3 all text) and does not isolate the title (S4 not used). Method output: daten/iso/ladder/scratch/err_recompose_nos4_<split>.json (script err_recompose3.py).

scope_rule.definition: The converter claims a document only if two converter signals both give an author role (proposal, response or combined): (1) m03_sub_common.role_of over the families of the text answers of the converter, (2) the S1 combined role of the document. Else the converter abstains on the whole document, and the document leaves the measurement.
inputs: converter answers of the document (13 answers per atom, before the collapse map)
S1 combined role: daten/iso/sub/s1_role/combined_<split>.json, field role (S1 rule; Apertus-v1.5-8B only for the rule id R1)
scope_rule.chosen_on: dev (in-sample): the intersection of the U4 signal and the ERR-L4 signal gave the highest exact rate at the atom unit (53 of 146) and at the block unit (108 of 147), and the fewest documents with block intrusion (11 and 15). Script ladder_scope_check.py.

levels.ech_output: Affair.title from the source record. One TextBlock for each block in Submission.texts or ResponseStep.texts. The text of a block includes the frame lines between its start and its end; each TextBlock gets the value status unsure for its extent. The fixed rules remove the page furniture.
levels.standard_grounding: A TextBlock (I95:402-416) has one text and one text_type; I95 says nothing about lines. E20 chapter 4 joins two runs of one answer into one block. Rule F and C2, C3, C7, C11 are project rules that this isolation level does not claim. The fixed answers stay, because the challenge asks for the cleanup of page furniture.

integrity_check.condition_1_reduction_changes_the_task: Each level L1 to L10 changes classes, unit, scope or abstention. LC1 is the only limit change and is kept apart.
integrity_check.condition_2_labels_from_ech_0295: Each coarse class is an I95 slot with the range TextBlock, or none, or furniture. L10 uses sets of these classes.
integrity_check.condition_3_scope_and_abstention_from_th: Scope and zone functions get the converter answers, the Docling blocks, the fixed answers and the stored converter signals only (ladder_impl.apply). Coverage is reported for each level.
integrity_check.condition_4_process_rules: Criteria are not written here (rule 1.5); LC1 and CC1 to CC5 are proposals for Jonathan. Rule 2.3 conflicts are listed for each level.
integrity_check.condition_5_final_measurement: No step here read test content, group 7 files or final_* files. The final measurement is in final_measurement.
integrity_check.trivial_check: Each level was measured with trivial converters (role only, all text, all none). R1 and R2 failed this check and were removed.

observations: No isolation level meets all criteria on dev with the stored outputs, although dev is in-sample.
Atom path: intrusion binds on dev at each isolation level (L7: 0.020) and on eval up to L5; omission binds on dev from L4 on; the exact rate binds on dev at each isolation level.
On eval (validation), L7, L8, L9 and L10 reach the point limit 0.80 of G3a.9.
L9 is nearest on both splits: dev 99 of 124 = 0.798 (in-sample), eval 15 of 15 (validation). It needs CC1, CC2, CC4, CC5 and a decision on LC1.
At L8 to L10 the method has 19 to 33 more exact dev documents than the trivial converter 'role only' on the same documents.
Variant L10v_role_agreement: dev 103 of 124 (0.831, in-sample), eval 15 of 15; it is a classification, not an isolation.
At each isolation level, method work on dev is necessary before a pass is plausible: frame blocks claimed as text, the start author without a cue, documents without a text field.
final_measurement: Jonathan selects one isolation level and its variant.
Write the gate criteria before the measurement (process rule 1.5), with LC1 and CC1 to CC5 decided.
Get human acceptance of the comparison basis: the gold set records of the test parliaments, reviewed by Jonathan (process rule 2.1).
Freeze ladder.json, ladder_impl.py and the converter code; record the SHA-256 values in the protocol (process rule 2.7).
Run the converter once on the test documents (the S1 Apertus signal of L6 and L7 needs CSCS requests in that step).
Derive the E20 answers of each gold set record (m03_gold_record.derive), apply the collapse map, the scope and the zones, and measure.
Calculate G3a.3 on the two AI codings of the final documents with the same map, scope and zones.
Report all levels L0 to L10 in one table from the same frozen run, with the coverage columns and the trivial check.
